race.comment: LAURIE DEE (1) drew widest and didn't feature at Newcastle last start but was racing well at that venue prior including a win over a mile three back. Looks well placed here and should get every chance from the inside draw. DE LA RENTA NZ (5) boxed on okay to finish fifth last start at Newcastle. She'll relish the return to a circuit where she is unbeaten in three starts. Leading hope. SUPERBON (3) has been coming from the back row of late and was solid when fourth here two back. Draws better so he is is on the radar. DOUBLE LINES (8) may need some luck form the back row but should find this easier than his most recent appearance at Newcastle.
